question: Should `/context detail` grow a provider-aware Codex context ledger, and should any new buckets affect compaction warnings or remain diagnostics-only?
rationale: The source can prove the generic residual label remains, but the correct bucket names and compaction semantics depend on maintainer intent and live Codex token-contract interpretation.

options.title: Add diagnostics-only ledger

options.body: Keep the current generic overhead line and document that Codex/native residuals are intentionally not classified.

options.title: Wait for live provider proof

recommendation.title: Add diagnostics-only ledger
